name: house-t1-b-taiga
description: Daub House, the taiga look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Daub House drawn again as a log lodge: a spruce log pen with notched corners, a broad 45-degree slate gable to the road over a recessed porch and a pent on log posts, a log kitchen cross-wing with its own gable, a fieldstone stack up the back gable. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes a candidate.
